youtube.title: Spartan mom sent her son to war with ONE rule 🛡️ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Spartan moms were built different. 🛡️

Other moms say "be safe". A Spartan mom says: come back WITH your shield, or ON it.

Spartan mom or your mom? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch's Sayings of Spartan Women: a Spartan mother handed her son his shield and told him "with it or on it" (come back victorious, or carried home dead on it). Dropping your shield to run was the ultimate Spartan disgrace.
